## Equity Quantitative Investment Strategies

[Lecturer · Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne · 2nd year of Master in Banking and Finance · 2026–2027]{.entry-meta}

This course is designed to provide an introduction to quantitative investing and especially to low-mid frequency systematic equity strategies (aka factor investing under its academic name). This course blends theoretical aspects (which are important!) such as CAPM, APT, linear regression, machine learning, factor construction and portfolio optimization with practical implementation (implementation is of equal importance!) such as Python in OOP, Git, GitHub, Docker and AWS (S3, EC2).

- <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> [Course description](../files/teaching/equity-quant-strategies/course-description.pdf)
- <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> [Slides](../files/teaching/equity-quant-strategies/slides.pdf)

## Python for Finance

[Lecturer · Paris-Dauphine, PSL · 1st year of Master in Economics and Finance · 2026–2027]{.entry-meta}

This course is designed to provide an introduction to the Python programming language with applications in finance (gradient descent, ARCH/GARCH, linear regression, dynamic conditional correlation, Markowitz optimization, index construction).
